author: notshekharsahu
name: waves-shader
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Waves style, generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#02010A, #04052E, #3D2C8D, #916BBF). Features: cursor-reactive (spotlight), high intensity. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
